_about: Each tool's size budget (scratch/tools/DESIGN-tool-template-fable.md §2.3), refused over by scripts/tools/check-tool-budgets.mjs: minified JS of its phone half and of its web half (each with its core half), bytes of bundled data (*.json and *.table.ts in its folders), and sentences of its own (keys no screen outside a tool uses). A tool that needs more says why in its PR and gets an entry in `tools`, e.g. "things": { "sentences": 180, "reason": "…" }; an entry without a reason is refused.
